# bdk-craft - the bdk-craft plugin

::: v-pre

Engineering craft skills that change what an agent does: test-driven development, debugging, refactoring, testing strategy and Mermaid diagrams. Works alone, without bdk.

## Skills

### `/bdk-craft:debugging` {#debugging}

`/bdk-craft:debugging`

Started by: you, or Claude when your request matches the description below.

Root-cause debugging - reproduce the bug as a failing test before touching the code, rank hypotheses by evidence, fix the cause, keep the test, and search for the same defect elsewhere. Load it before reading or editing code for any bug report, error, stack trace, wrong result, flaky test or "it worked yesterday".

### `/bdk-craft:mermaid-drawer` {#mermaid-drawer}

`/bdk-craft:mermaid-drawer`

Started by: you, or Claude when your request matches the description below.

Mermaid diagram standard - type chosen by the relationship shown, at most 15 nodes per diagram (split larger systems), labelled edges, colours legible in light and dark themes. Load it before writing any mermaid block, and whenever asked to draw or diagram an architecture, a flow, trust boundaries, a lifecycle or a data model.

### `/bdk-craft:refactoring` {#refactoring}

`/bdk-craft:refactoring`

Started by: you, or Claude when your request matches the description below.

Safe refactoring - pin today's behaviour with characterisation tests before the first edit, change structure in small named steps with the tests run after each, and report odd behaviour instead of silently fixing it. Load it before editing when asked to clean up, refactor, restructure, simplify or make code readable or maintainable.

### `/bdk-craft:tdd` {#tdd}

`/bdk-craft:tdd`

Started by: you, or Claude when your request matches the description below.

Test-driven development as a strict red-green-refactor loop, one behaviour at a time, with a failing test run seen before each piece of code. Load it before writing any code when the user asks to work test-first, TDD or "tests first", for a new function, a feature or a bug fix with a known cause.

### `/bdk-craft:testing-strategy` {#testing-strategy}

`/bdk-craft:testing-strategy`

Started by: you, or Claude when your request matches the description below.

Test strategy and test design choices - one job per test level, test doubles only at owned boundaries, Test Data Builders, Page Objects for browser tests, contract tests between services, injected clocks. Load it before answering any question about how to test a feature, service or app, before writing a test plan, and before writing example tests.

:::
